screening.reason: Exclusion 3: uses only structural (T1) MRI from ABIDE I for a subcortical-structure segmentation CNN; segmentations are evaluated against FreeSurfer automatic labels (ABIDE has no ground-truth segmentation) and robustness is assessed across site/age/diagnosis groups, but there is no resting-state functional connectivity analysis or autism-vs-control diagnostic/connectivity finding.

evidence_quotes: ABIDE I involved 17 international sites, sharing previously collected resting state functional magnetic resonance imaging (R-fMRI), anatomical and phenotypic datasets

This eﬀort yielded a huge dataset containing 1112 subjects, including 539 from individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and 573 from typical controls (ages 7-64 years, median 14.7 years across groups).
